snippet.title: ENDLESS Legend 2 - Aspects Faction Spotlight | Fantasy 4X
snippet.description:
In this second episode of the Endless Legend 2 Faction Spotlight, Lucie Graffagnino (Associate Producer) provides more context on  the Aspects, a diplomatic faction born from the symbiosis of the organic and the machine.

United by the Chorus, they are constantly seeking harmony for all beings, using their coral spores to maintain balance in Saiadha. Will you lead the Aspects to victory?
